changed_descriptions.before: Enables you to browse the ROCKNIX filesystem and manage files directly on your device. You can also use this tool to copy files from external drives to your ROCKNIX filesystem.
changed_descriptions.after: Browse files on your device and copy files to or from external drives.

changed_descriptions.before: Use this utility to install ROCKNIX to the local storage on your device. Note: This process will wipe the drive that you choose to install ROCKNIX on.
changed_descriptions.after: Install pixelelated to your device's local storage. This erases all data on the drive you select.

changed_descriptions.before: PortMaster is a simple tool that allows you to download various game ports that are available for ROCKNIX and other ARM based devices. You can find details at portmaster.games
changed_descriptions.after: Download game ports for pixelelated and other supported devices. Learn more at portmaster.games.

changed_descriptions.before: Backup your saves to a cloud drive using RCLONE. Please make sure you have followed the steps at rocknix.org to set up RCLONE first.
changed_descriptions.after: Back up saves to your cloud storage. Set up your cloud account in Game Settings > Cloud Settings first.

changed_descriptions.before: Restores your saves from a cloud drive using RCLONE. Please make sure you have followed the steps at rocknix.org to set up RCLONE first.
changed_descriptions.after: Restore saves from your cloud storage. Set up your cloud account in Game Settings > Cloud Settings first.
